name: Having A Vasectomy
overview: Scripture affirms the blessing and importance of children as a heritage from the Lord and a reward from the fruit of the womb, highlighting the value of offspring in God's design for families and legacy. God commands humanity to be fruitful and multiply, emphasizing the role of procreation in fulfilling His purposes. The narratives of biblical figures such as Elisabeth conceiving after a time of waiting illustrate God's sovereign involvement in the gift of children. Together, these verses underscore the sacredness of life and the divine intention for growth within the family.
